messages:
emily: Heads-up: enterprise support reported doubled quota numbers on Console for several orgs after the new telemetry tags landed. screenshots incoming.

raj: do we have an example payload that reproduces?

emily: yes — staging request: 

```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer sk_ent_999,
  x-redwood-org: org_ent_42,
  x-redwood-project: proj_900
}
```

Console shows two series: quota{owner=org_ent_42} and quota{token_origin=sk_ent_999} and sums them. billing customers see >100% usage.

jin: root cause: telemetry emits both owner and token_origin for visibility. Console aggregation used to prefer owner when present; a recent query rewrite removed that preference.

maria: fix options: 1) pipeline single canonical_owner tag (cheap cardinality), 2) console rollup logic to prefer owner tag, 3) hybrid: emit canonical_owner + keep token_origin as debug dimension. I prefer hybrid for safety.

sam: hybrid sounds safe. Console default rollup should use canonical_owner. Expose token_origin as optional breakdown behind a toggle.

raj: one risk: legacy keys without project binding — owner resolution will be 'legacy:key' which should be excluded from billing rollups. Need clear mapping rules.

jin: plan for canary: pipeline adds canonical_owner values: "project:proj_900", "org:org_ent_42", or "legacy:key:sk_ent_999". token_origin still emitted but flagged debug=true. Console default uses canonical_owner for totals.

emily: and how do we handle historical charts? we can't reprocess months cheaply.

maria: implement a query-time compatibility layer: when canonical_owner missing, do a fast lookup to attribution service to resolve token -> owner for display only. Mark such charts with "compat view" badge.

sam: add a billing compatibility view: invoices always use billing_view=compat for 30 days to guarantee no surprises. After the migration window, billing_view flips to canonical by default.

deploy-bot: deploying telemetry-canonical-owner canary to 10% traffic.

observability-bot: muted alert 'quota-doubling' until 1702080000 by emily.

raj: test checklist: synthetic requests with (a) project header, (b) org-only header, (c) legacy key with no headers. Assert canonical_owner emitted correctly and totals match single increment. Also check console toggle behavior.

jin: I'll open PR for pipeline change + unit tests. will ping ux/frontend for the toggle and badge work.

maria: UX note: show an orange "mixed attribution" tooltip when graph contains both pre/post canonical data. Also add a help link "Why did my usage change?" for CS.

emily: agreed. timeline: canary 48h, reconcile after 72h, promote if diffs <0.5%.

sam: add runbook entry: how to answer customer questions and revert steps if billing mismatch found.

raj: once PRs are ready drop links here and I'll review.

emily: thanks all — I'll coordinate on CS comms once canary starts. :thumbsup:
